source_derived_rule_inventory.source_meaning: Where financial or property statements are required under the Division, the source rule permits a party to serve Form 15-52 once without leave and at another time with Court leave or written consent of the opposite party.
Requested information is limited by the supplied rule to existing documents in the control of the opposite party.
The supplied rule and form state a 30-day response period after service.
A party objecting to disclosure must make the objection in writing, state the reason, and serve the objection together with information not objected to within the response time.
The form warns that failure to provide requested documents may result in an application for Court orders or other remedies identified in the form.
The form requires continuing correction when information supplied in response is later found incorrect, incomplete, or materially changed.
